description_en: Queries the projects whose names start with apisec- in Simple Log Service
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-apisec-sls-projects --instance-id waf_v3_public_cn-uqm2z00000a --log-region-id cn-hangzhou --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeApisecSlsProjects

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query the ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html获取当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where logs are stored.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2712598.html operation to query available log storage regions
parameters.help_zh:
日志存储地域ID。


您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2712598.html接口查询用户可用的日志存储地域
parameters.name: log_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
